Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: urgent stabilization
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: Emergency care to stop immediate death risk. Not a cure: the underlying injury remains, but the patient is safe to travel again.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: urgent veterinary stabilization
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: Emergency care to stop an animal's immediate death risk. Not a cure: the underlying injury remains, but the animal is safe to travel again.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: extended treatment
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: A five-day treatment plan that automatically cures every ordinary injury and curable disease and tends every condition that can only be managed, not cured. Long-term rehabilitation takes longer but also cures addictions. The patient stays with the settlement's medical staff for the duration and is returned once care is complete.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: extended veterinary treatment
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: A five-day treatment plan that automatically cures every ordinary injury and curable disease and tends every condition that can only be managed, not cured. Long-term rehabilitation takes longer but also cures addictions. The animal stays with the settlement's handlers for the duration and is returned once care is complete.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: surgery
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: Install a prosthetic or bionic body part. Lists only implants and body parts compatible with the patient; medicine and the implant itself are consumed from settlement stock or the caravan's own supply. A caravan may also bring a compatible listed part itself: assigned as a supplied material, it is not billed as an implant, and only the operation charge remains.

Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: veterinary surgery
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: Install a prosthetic or bionic body part on an animal. Lists only implants and body parts compatible with the patient; medicine and the implant itself are consumed from settlement stock or the caravan's own supply. A caravan may also bring a compatible listed part itself: assigned as a supplied material, it is not billed as an implant, and only the operation charge remains.
